claims: Nottingham Forest won 3-0 against Tottenham Hotspur on March 22, 2026 at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.
The loss left Tottenham Hotspur in 17th place.
The defeat kept Igor Tudor's Tottenham Hotspur in 17th place just one point above the relegation zone.
Tottenham Hotspur remained the only Premier League team without a win in the 2026 calendar year up to March 22.
Tottenham Hotspur took only five points from 13 matches in the 2026 calendar year up to March 22.
Nottingham Forest converted two out of three big chances created.
Tottenham Hotspur missed four big chances.
